text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon.
After a study session between Trainers ended,
I was walking through the academy with a junior Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Where is it?

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? ...Ah!
Whoa, I didn't notice that at all...

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text: A true Trainer really can spot their Umamusume faster than the speed of light!

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Come to think of it...
Her vibe seems to have changed a bit, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, before this, she always kind of...
seemed sort of uneasy, but...

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Right now—she looks so happy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, was your junior... alright?
Were you two in the middle of talking?
choice_data_list: It's okay. More importantly... were you waiting for me?
It's okay. More importantly... were you waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes.
Um... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any plans
for your next... day off?
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure there wasn't, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...!
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Would you... like to go out somewhere with me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, on the morning of our next day off...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Good morning. Sorry, did I keep you waiting?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No!
...I only just got here myself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Um, well...
...Er, I didn't see the sunrise, no...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply sorry...
...Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hot Hachimi, it says.
...Looks delicious...
choice_data_list: Shall we buy two and drink them at the park?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'd like that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: P-Please wait! Please... let me try...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um...
Two small Hot Hachimies, please...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ......H-Hot Hachimi...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, excuse me...! Two small hot Hachimis,
please...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
!
Right away!
Please wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—Phew...
That Hachimitsu was delicious, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. To be honest, I could've gone with a Regular size.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well then... could it be that you're in the mood
for something a little sweeter?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If so...
um, if it's alright with you—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's... Day.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Yes... it's Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite particular
when it comes to chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: This time, I've selected around 10 exquisite pieces from my favorite brand.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "I really wanted you to taste the very best, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I've prepared a handwritten explanation, but... I'll also walk you through it verbally.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Starting from the top right, clockwise...
From a long-established American brand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Still in Love talk with such unusual excitement
warmed my heart.
Our peaceful outing continued on—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I blended different types of cacao
to create an original mix.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Though I did wonder if I was overstepping my bounds.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No matter what...
I really wanted to give you something I made with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I went a bit too far... didn't I?
If... you don't like it—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate I received from Still in Love...
was very sweet.
And so, our peaceful outing continued—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The sunlight is so warm...
Both my heart and body feel nice and cozy.
choice_data_list: Isn't the sun a bit strong today? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... The thing is, it hasn't actually been that painful lately...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I often read books
while basking in the sun.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Very much so!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...It truly feels like a dream. To think...
such a peaceful day would ever come."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Just like an ordinary girl...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"So... right now, before going to sleep each night...
I write down one thing I want to do in my diary."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Though it's quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Now that I try to think about it, nothing comes to mind...
Though yesterday, I...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I want to go to a flower garden...
The thought just suddenly came to me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere much wider than here...
Covered in flowers as far as the eye can see!
With only light, and the wind, and nothing else...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The ones there were me, and—
......

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me.
If... if you ever find such a place..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Will you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Still...! But... by that time,
I surely won't... be at Tracen Academy anymore."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No fighting spirit, no running...
I would just be... plain old Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I'm sure they're waiting for you to visit.
I'm sure they're waiting for you to visit.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I can still... stay by your side, can't I?
...Then...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... there is just one thing
that terrifies me."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"It's the fear that if she keeps running like this...
that girl might wake up again..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Losing one's peace and tranquility.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I... really love this peaceful life right now.
That's why... I...—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Once the Kinko Sho is over...
I'm going to—stop running."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's cheerful words were
the very picture of pure happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To the point that even just thinking 'I want you to reconsider'
felt like a sin."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enabling Umamusume to run at their absolute best
is a Trainer's mission and duty.
I really ought to stop her, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if she made that decision after accomplishing such a great feat... then I have no choice but to respect it. ...And that's how it should be.
—Because she is smiling, after all.
choice_data_list: ...Can I see your bucket list later?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Let's figure out where to start together.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm looking forward to it—
